title: Labeling Organic Products | Agricultural Marketing Service
summary: USDA rules for organic labelling categories, certification, exemptions and use of the seal.

assertions.quote: Any product that contains a minimum of 95 percent organic ingredients (excluding salt and water)
Product contains at least 70 percent organically produced ingredients (excluding salt and water)
Produced without excluded or prohibited methods, (e.g., genetic engineering, ionizing radiation, or sewage sludge)
Producers who market less than $5,000 worth of organic products annually are not required to apply for organic certification
Organic product labels must be reviewed and approved by a USDA-accredited certifying agent before being used in the marketplace.

verdicts.note: Under the NOP rules, certifiers review and approve organic labels as part of certification.
